label: 🖼️ IMAGEN / CONCEPTO, TODAVÍA HAY QUE CONSTRUIRLO
armature_note: Meshy armature node carries scale 0.01 (bones authored in cm); skinned mesh world height is 1.8 m. Godot import: keep, or apply root scale on import.

textures.note: Rigged Meshy output only carries baseColor; normal/ORM from the retexture task were not carried through the rig.

weapons.model: double-bit axe, 0.65 m, ~3k tris, 1024 WebP, origin = grip point 1/4 up the haft, on the haft axis. Haft = axe +Y (glTF), blades = axe X.
weapons.attach_note: BoneAttachment3D(bone) -> axe transform in the glTF joint space with joint scale removed. Haft runs through the closed fist; head on the thumb side; blades along the forearm axis (forward in the stance, head up).

holster.note: Both axes crossed on the back (X), heads down, hafts over the shoulders. Switch BoneAttachment to UpperChest with these transforms when the clip starts.

clips_standard: lowercase snake_case, 30 fps (retimed from Meshy 24 fps), in place: Hips horizontal translation flattened (root rotation kept)

clips.name: idle
clips.off_hand_axe: Mirror: off-hand axe hangs head-down at left side; breathing reads fine with both. Base is Axe_Breathe (single axe).

clips.name: walk
clips.off_hand_axe: Both axes hang head-down; Slow_Orc arm swing is symmetric, so the left axe already mirrors the right.

clips.name: run
clips.off_hand_axe: Both axes trail; charge arm pump is symmetric. Tweak: raise both heads off the thighs.

clips.name: turn_l
clips.off_hand_axe: Clip holds right arm high; left axe stays low. Tweak: lower right arm to the idle pose.

clips.name: turn_r
clips.off_hand_axe: Idle turn, axes hang. Ends ~180 deg rotated (root rotation kept).

clips.name: attack_melee_1
clips.off_hand_axe: Charged_Axe_Chop: right axe chops; left axe COMPLEMENTS by bracing low/back. Custom: left follow-up chop on the recovery for a 1-2.

clips.name: attack_melee_2
clips.off_hand_axe: Double_Combo_Attack: right then left strike; second axe mirrors the first. Best native dual-weapon clip.

clips.name: attack_ranged
clips.off_hand_axe: Crouch_Pull_and_Throw used as an axe throw: right axe is thrown (hide R axe at release, respawn on recovery); left stays in hand.

clips.name: cast
clips.off_hand_axe: Sword_Shout war-cry: right axe raised overhead; left axe mirrors low. Custom: raise both for a berserk roar.

clips.name: hit
clips.off_hand_axe: Generic hit react; both axes flail with the arms.

clips.name: block
clips.off_hand_axe: Two_Handed_Parry: both fists meet overhead, so the two axes cross like an X block. Custom: separate the hands ~10 cm so the hafts do not intersect.

clips.name: push
clips.off_hand_axe: Shield_Push_Left: left forearm shove; read as an off-hand axe-haft shove. Right axe low.

clips.name: dodge
clips.off_hand_axe: Stand_Dodge sidestep; axes passive.

clips.name: downed
clips.off_hand_axe: Knock_Down; axes stay in hands while on the ground (detach/drop is optional in Godot).

clips.name: death
clips.off_hand_axe: dying_backwards; recommend detaching both axes on impact to avoid clipping into the floor.

clips.name: interact
clips.off_hand_axe: open_door; right hand reaches with the axe still in it. Custom: hide R axe or tuck it in the belt during interact.

clips.name: sit
clips.off_hand_axe: Chair_Sit_Idle_M; axes rest across the knees (clips into thighs). Custom: unequip for sit.

clips.name: victory
clips.off_hand_axe: Victory_Fist_Pump: right axe pumped up; left mirrors low. Custom: both axes up.

clips.name: ironjaw_axe_stance
clips.off_hand_axe: Axe_Stance (single-axe transition): right axe forward guard; Custom: mirror left arm to hold the second axe forward-low.

clips.name: ironjaw_axe_spin
clips.off_hand_axe: Axe_Spin_Attack single-axe: right axe leads; left arm is extended in the spin, so the left axe naturally adds a second arc (reads as a dual spin).

clips.name: ironjaw_double_blade_spin
clips.off_hand_axe: Double_Blade_Spin: authored for two blades, both axes work as-is. Signature dual clip.

clips.name: ironjaw_ground_slam
clips.off_hand_axe: Charged_Ground_Slam: right arm slams; Custom: drive both axes into the ground together for the brute read.

clips.name: ironjaw_taunt
clips.off_hand_axe: Chest_Pound_Taunt: pounding with fists clips the axe heads into the chest. Custom: pound with haft butts, or hide axes.

clips.name: ironjaw_jump
clips.off_hand_axe: Regular_Jump; axes passive. Custom: axes up on the landing for weight.

clips.name: ironjaw_climb
clips.off_hand_axe: Ladder_Climb_Loop; axes would clip ladder rungs. Custom: holster both on the back while climbing.

grip.method: Sculpted closed-fist bind shape: the hand mesh is 1-piece gauntlet (~180 finger verts per hand, no separate finger geometry), so finger bones were NOT added. Finger verts beyond the knuckle line (12 cm along the hand joint) are wrapped around a 3.1 cm-radius haft cylinder (up to 260 deg). Weights unchanged (Hand bone), so the fist is identical in every clip and on every LOD.
grip.grip_point: 25% up from haft bottom (axe glb origin moved here, centred on the haft axis)
grip.axes_identical: axe_R and axe_L have identical geometry/materials (only node names differ)
